authoring_method: Independent source STL multiview review plus raw triangle-plane sections. Production detector output was not used as the expected-feature denominator.
scope: 11 selected closed inner-wall sections: six on the left shell and five on one left leg instance. Other surfaces, slots, entrances and instances remain explicitly unreviewed unless separately recorded.

independence.denominator: Manually selected source sections after viewing the isolated source mesh; raw section closure and inward winding are recomputed by the standalone helper.
limitations: This finite sample tests omissions at known source locations; it does not establish arbitrary-direction coverage or whole-device recall.
Triangle indices are zero-based original binary-STL facet indices.
Radii are source-mesh measurements, not manufacturing tolerances.
Each item is a wall-section witness, not necessarily a distinct logical hole.

supports: source facet geometry and local coordinates only
conflicts: The simulator reference model is not evidence of alpha hardware assembly, screw specification or real engagement.

sources.query: Find exact-version model purpose and a shell fastener/assembly drawing link.
sources.observed: Read the captured README model section (lines 124 onward) and inspected its hardware/assembly references. It identifies the MJCF as an Onshape export and the repository as RL training/runtime infrastructure; no per-hole shell connection definition was located in that text.
supports: Purpose and model-export origin of the frozen simulation project.
limitations: The README model export link points to an Onshape workspace, not a frozen CAD version. A per-hole assembly drawing was not located in this file; it may exist elsewhere.

sources.query: Find a shell assembly guide in exact-version documentation directory.
limitations: The inspected top-level directory listing did not provide a shell assembly drawing. Nested documents were not exhaustively reviewed.

sources.query: Locate matching shell/CAD/BOM/mechanical assembly files in the archived official alpha runtime revision.
sources.method: Inspected the complete nontruncated Git tree and filtered path names for assembl|hardware|cad|mechanic|shell|bom|design.
sources.observed: The matching entries were docs/design and software/network/simulation design notes; no shell/CAD/BOM/assembly-named path was returned.
limitations: This path-name search does not establish that no useful unnamed document exists, and this alpha runtime revision is not automatically the STL mechanical revision.

sources.observed: Inspected the captured manufacturer image-index include, which links the generic horn screw and assembly illustrations.
limitations: Manufacturer-general diagrams do not determine the left-shell Z hole function, actual Microduck connection or retention.

sources.query: Locate the CAD source linked by this exact model-export revision.
sources.observed: The configuration identifies an Onshape workspace URL and STL simplification settings; the JSON fixes the export configuration, but it does not pin the changing CAD workspace to the STL revision.
supports: Provenance link from the fixed model configuration to its CAD workspace.
limitations: No part function, fastener or retaining role is established by the export configuration.

sources.query: Inspect matching assembly CAD and identify the left-shell Z-hole counterpart and insertion side.
sources.attempted_method: web open of the actual source URL
sources.observed: The web tool returned: URL is not accessible via this tool.
limitations: No CAD content was obtained. No authentication requirement or permanent availability claim is inferred from this tool failure.
sources.next_action: Obtain a frozen CAD export or accessible assembly drawing for the matching STL revision.

supports: Actually performed source-section, common-configuration, dimensional, model-index, original-photo and manufacturer-general diagram checks; separately scoped project interpretations.
limitations: Project research is not a user statement, manufacturer device-specific assembly instruction or manufacturing approval.
